name: Troll, Advanced
body:
Advanced Troll
CR 6

XP 2,400
CE Large humanoid (giant)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +7 natural, –1 size)
hp 75 (6d8+48); regeneration 5 (acid or fire)
Fort +13, Ref +6, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +10 (1d8+7), 2 claws +8 (1d6+7)
Ranged large heavy crossbow +7 (2d8/19–20)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks rend (2 claws, 1d6+10)

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 18, Con 27, Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 10
Base Atk +4; CMB +12; CMD 26
Feats Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Intimidate +16, Perception +13
Languages Giant
Gear large heavy crossbow with 20 bolts

ECOLOGY (FROM TROLL)

Environment cold mountains
Organization solitary or gang (2–4)
Treasure standard
